description: Multi-agent orchestration state machine for FastAPI, SQLAlchemy Async, Redis Cluster, and K8s deployment

responsibilities: Database schema review and migration planning
Nginx reverse proxy and kernel sysctl tuning
Feature implementation adhering to Repository Pattern
Service layer business logic and domain lifecycle hooks
FastAPI endpoint handlers and Pydantic schemas
Clean architecture and SOLID compliance audit
Zero N+1 query and cache invalidation race checks
Linting, test execution, and merge approval

TASK_SPECIFICATION.action: Analyze requirement, draft Architectural Decision Record (ADR), specify schemas and database boundaries.

IMPLEMENTATION.action: Write domain code, implement repository methods, pluggable hooks, schemas, and unit tests.

STATIC_VERIFICATION.action: Run run_linter.sh, compile bytecode, and execute local pytest suite.

CODE_REVIEW.action: Perform architectural audit, security inspection, and output CodeReviewReport.

GIT_COMMIT_PREPARATION.action: Invoke git_helper.py to check for secret leaks, verify clean staging, and execute conventional commit.

DEPLOYMENT_READINESS.action: Verify Docker multi-stage build, K8s liveness/readiness probes, and Nginx reverse proxy configuration.
